thinking_text:
**Analyzing sprocket design**

I'm considering the outer sprocket body, possibly a BMX sprocket or chainring. It has a central fine spline and 36 outer teeth, which could indicate it’s for an e-bike. I should identify it as a bicycle cassette sprocket or chainring. The +Z face features a lobed central ring, and the -Z face has a black circular hub plate. I need to carefully map its features and logical ranges, focusing on the solid structure and its faces.

part.name: Splined bicycle sprocket or cassette cog with separate center insert

part_functions.name: Chain torque transmission
part_functions.function: The circumferential teeth engage a roller chain and transmit torque between the chain and the central splined shaft or carrier.

part_functions.name: Rotary shaft interface
part_functions.function: The fine internal spline provides a coaxial, non-slip rotational interface to a mating hub, driver, or shaft.

part_functions.name: Lightweight structural support
part_functions.function: The perforated web and curved radial ribs connect the center hub to the toothed rim while limiting mass and retaining bending and torsional stiffness.

part_functions.name: Axial location and retention
part_functions.function: The stepped center insert and annular shoulders provide axial bearing and retention surfaces between the sprocket and its mating carrier.

section_functions.name: Torque-coupling insert
section_functions.function: Forms the primary internal spline and transfers torque into the surrounding sprocket center through a stiff, axially extended hub body.

section_functions.name: Coaxial locating member
section_functions.function: Concentric cylindrical, conical, and planar shoulders locate the insert relative to the sprocket body and mating shaft.

features.name: Front annular cap and entry bevel

feature_functions.name: Spline entry and axial shoulder
feature_functions.function: The planar annulus provides an axial reference while the conical edge guides assembly and removes a sharp entry edge.

feature_functions.name: Relationship to spline bore
feature_functions.function: This feature is coaxial with and directly adjacent to the internal spline; it also supports the surrounding insert barrel.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Circumferential front entry chamfer between the outer barrel and front annular face.
Front axial annular bearing face surrounding the splined opening.
Outer cylindrical wall immediately behind the front entry chamfer.

features.name: Fine internal spline bore

feature_functions.name: Positive torque transmission
feature_functions.function: Repeated axial spline teeth mechanically lock the insert to a mating splined shaft and resist circumferential slip.

feature_functions.name: Load distribution
feature_functions.function: The large number of narrow spline teeth distributes torque around the bore and reduces load on each individual tooth.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationship
feature_functions.function: All spline faces are axially parallel, circumferentially repeated, coaxial with the sprocket, and bounded by the front and rear annular shoulders.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Circumferentially repeated planar spline flanks and narrow crest/root lands extending through the insert thickness; each face in this range belongs to the internal spline profile.
Short cylindrical root-transition segments between adjacent spline flanks; each face completes the repeated internal spline bore.

features.name: Rear lobed flange and stepped barrel

feature_functions.name: Axial retention
feature_functions.function: The rear flange and stepped annular surfaces bear against the sprocket center or mating carrier and restrict axial displacement.

feature_functions.name: Torque transfer to sprocket body
feature_functions.function: The non-circular lobed perimeter increases rotational interlock and contact area between the insert and surrounding center region.

feature_functions.name: Relationship to web hub
feature_functions.function: This feature is coaxial with the web hub, overlaps its central opening, and is structurally separate in the STEP model as solid 0.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Local rear step, short cylindrical transitions, and edge rounds beginning the lobed flange profile.
Circumferential sequence of cylindrical wall segments forming the scalloped or lobed flange perimeter.
Intermediate planar annular shoulder between the stepped barrel and lobed rear flange.
Axially extended curved wall segments completing the repeated rear flange and barrel geometry.
Rear planar flange face surrounding the spline bore.

section_functions.name: Radial load path
section_functions.function: Transfers chain-induced tangential and radial loads from the outer rim to the central hub through curved ribs and annular bridges.

section_functions.name: Mass reduction
section_functions.function: Large rounded openings remove low-stress material while retaining continuous structural paths between the hub and rim.

section_functions.name: Out-of-plane stiffness
section_functions.function: Raised borders, fillets, and locally thickened ribs resist sprocket dish deformation and distribute bending loads.

features.name: Rear web surface and opening boundaries

feature_functions.name: Rear structural skin
feature_functions.function: Provides a largely continuous rear-side load-carrying surface around the hub, ribs, and rim.

feature_functions.name: Opening edge support
feature_functions.function: Rounded and blended boundaries suppress stress concentration around the large weight-reduction apertures.

feature_functions.name: Relationship to front web
feature_functions.function: The rear web is axially opposite and approximately symmetric to the front web, with both joined by the aperture sidewalls and rib edges.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Rear-side blended web and rim-transition patches, including rounded junctions around the openings and outer annulus.
Large rear planar web face spanning the perforated sprocket body.

features.name: Curved radial ribs and aperture walls

feature_functions.name: Torsional reinforcement
feature_functions.function: Curved radial ribs carry tangential chain load toward the hub and resist local shear between adjacent apertures.

feature_functions.name: Aperture definition
feature_functions.function: Smooth sidewalls define the large rounded triangular, teardrop, and slot-like lightening openings.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationships
feature_functions.function: The ribs are continuous with both the central annulus and outer rim, are arranged in an approximately rotationally symmetric pattern, and mutually brace neighboring rim sectors.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Sequential sidewalls, fillets, and transition surfaces around one set of large and small web apertures and their intervening ribs.
Continuation around the web: curved rib flanks, aperture walls, annular bridges, and blended rim-side junctions.

features.name: Front web surface and raised rib borders

feature_functions.name: Front structural skin
feature_functions.function: Closes the front side of the rib network and spreads local loads over broad planar and blended surfaces.

feature_functions.name: Edge stiffening
feature_functions.function: Raised and radiused borders around openings increase local section modulus and protect aperture edges.

feature_functions.name: Relationship to center and rim
feature_functions.function: The front web is integral with the central annulus and outer rim and is connected to the rear web through the ribs and aperture walls.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Front-side rib and aperture transition patches immediately preceding the main front planar skin.
Large front planar web face containing the multiple aperture boundary wires.
Front-side raised borders, blended rib surfaces, aperture-edge fillets, and transitions into the central and outer annuli.

section_functions.name: Insert support
section_functions.function: Provides the annular seat surrounding the separate splined insert and spreads torque into the radial web.

section_functions.name: Hub-to-web reinforcement
section_functions.function: A thickened central annulus reduces stress where the narrow ribs converge and supports axial loads from the insert.

features.name: Rear hub recess and annular shoulder

feature_functions.name: Axial seating
feature_functions.function: The recessed planar annulus and rounded transition provide a seating surface for the separate center insert or an adjacent drivetrain component.

feature_functions.name: Relationship to insert
feature_functions.function: The recess is coaxial with solid 0 and adjacent to the central spline assembly.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Rounded annular transition between the rear hub recess and surrounding web.
Rear recessed annular seating face around the central opening.
Circumferential hub-to-rib transition surfaces and local fillets connecting the rear recess to the perforated web.

features.name: Central annular seat and front hub transition

feature_functions.name: Radial and axial support
feature_functions.function: The cylindrical and conical seat surfaces center the insert and react radial and axial loads at the sprocket center.

feature_functions.name: Stress distribution
feature_functions.function: Repeated conical and curved transitions distribute load from the hub into the radial ribs without abrupt section changes.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationship
feature_functions.function: This feature is concentric with the spline bore, integral with solid 1, and directly supports the inner ends of all web ribs.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Circumferential sequence of short conical hub-seat transition patches on the rear side.
Axially extended cylindrical segments defining the main-body central seat around the insert.
Front-side conical transition sequence between the cylindrical hub seat and front annular face.
Front planar annular hub face surrounding the center insert.
Outer front chamfer of the main-body hub annulus.
Outer cylindrical wall of the main-body hub annulus.

section_functions.name: Chain engagement
section_functions.function: Repeated circumferential teeth enter the chain roller spaces and convert chain tension into sprocket torque.

section_functions.name: Wear and contact management
section_functions.function: Chamfered, crowned, and blended tooth surfaces guide chain engagement, reduce edge impact, and distribute roller contact.

section_functions.name: Rim reinforcement
section_functions.function: The continuous annular base beneath the teeth ties the web ribs together and distributes load between neighboring teeth.

features.name: Tooth roots and primary radial flanks

feature_functions.name: Roller load reaction
feature_functions.function: Primary tooth flanks react chain roller contact and transfer tangential force into the annular rim.

feature_functions.name: Root stress control
feature_functions.function: Curved root and transition surfaces reduce stress concentration where each tooth joins the rim.

feature_functions.name: Pattern relationship
feature_functions.function: The surfaces form a repeated circumferential pattern, share a common rotational axis with the hub, and are structurally continuous with the rim.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Repeated tooth-side planes, cylindrical root rounds, and conical transition surfaces around the first axial half of the outer circumference.
Intermediate planar annular rim surface bounded by the repeated tooth-root profile.
Continuation of the repeated primary tooth flanks and root transitions around the circumference.

features.name: Front tooth crowns and guide chamfers

feature_functions.name: Chain entry guidance
feature_functions.function: Front-side chamfers and rounded crowns guide rollers and chain side plates onto the sprocket.

feature_functions.name: Edge durability
feature_functions.function: Blended crown surfaces avoid fragile sharp edges and reduce impact stress during engagement.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationship
feature_functions.function: These surfaces are adjacent to the primary tooth flanks and form the front axial termination of each repeated tooth.

brep_faces.semantic_role: First circumferential band of front tooth crowns, rounded valleys, and blended guide surfaces.
Outer front chamfer band and repeated transition faces leading from tooth crowns toward the front rim face.

features.name: Mid-plane tooth band and circumferential valley blends

feature_functions.name: Continuous rim load sharing
feature_functions.function: The middle tooth band links neighboring tooth roots and spreads chain load circumferentially through the rim.

feature_functions.name: Smooth roller release
feature_functions.function: Rounded BSpline and toroidal valley surfaces provide gradual contact transition as chain rollers leave the sprocket.

feature_functions.name: Pattern relationship
feature_functions.function: The band is coaxial with the hub and rotationally repeated with the same pitch as the outer teeth.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Repeated mid-thickness tooth and valley surfaces on the rearward side of the rim.
Repeated mid-thickness tooth and valley surfaces on the frontward side of the rim.

features.name: Rear tooth crowns and exit chamfers

feature_functions.name: Chain exit guidance
feature_functions.function: Rear-side crown and chamfer surfaces guide chain release and accommodate minor chain-line misalignment.

feature_functions.name: Axial symmetry and balance
feature_functions.function: The rear tooth treatment approximately mirrors the front treatment, preserving balanced contact and avoiding a sharp rear edge.

feature_functions.name: Structural relationship
feature_functions.function: These surfaces terminate the rear side of each tooth and are adjacent to the middle tooth band and primary flanks.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Repeated rear-side tooth chamfers and blended crown transitions around the complete circumference.
Final rear axial band of rounded tooth crowns, valleys, and terminal edge blends.
